text:
ITEM 1 | Roasted drumstick-shaped piece, golden-brown to tan skin with darker browned patches and a slightly glossy sheen, the meat end exposed as a pale off-white cut surface with a fibrous texture, about 10 cm long and 4 cm thick at the widest, sitting at the upper right of the plate beside the greens | 110
ITEM 2 | Mixed salad greens with varied leaves in dark green, bright green, and burgundy-purple tones, some leaves glossy and some matte, wilted and limp in places, covering roughly 25% of the plate in a loose heap at the left | 45
ITEM 3 | Thin strips of red chili pepper, bright red with slightly glossy skin and pale seed-free flesh, about 4 to 5 cm long and 0.5 cm wide, scattered among the greens | 8
ITEM 4 | Pale green stalk piece, crisp-looking with a smooth surface, about 4 cm long, lying among the greens near the drumstick | 5
ITEM 5 | Round slice of yellow corn, bright golden-yellow with a textured kernel pattern and a cut face showing a central core, about 5 cm in diameter and 1.5 cm thick, sitting on the right edge of the greens | 35
ITEM 6 | Small browned fragments of cooked meat or skin, tan to dark brown with a slightly glossy surface, about 2 to 3 cm across, lying at the bottom edge of the greens | 10
